description_en: Queries the cloud products supported by Quota Center

name: ListProducts

parameters.help_en: The token that marks the position to start the query. If this parameter is empty, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记开始查询数据的位置。置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of records to return for the query.

Valid values: 1 to 200. Default: 30
parameters.help_zh:
本次查询的最大记录条数。

取值范围：1~200。默认值：30
